g.text: - Take I-77 North or I-71 North to Cleveland.
- Exit at Chester Ave. (Exit 173B) and turn right.
- Take Chester Ave. to Main Campus.
- Take I-80 West to I-480 (Exit 187) or take I-480 West.
- Merge onto I-271 North. (Do not use express lanes.)
- Exit at Cedar Rd. (Exit 32) and turn right.
- Drive approximately 8 miles and merge onto Carnegie Ave.
- Take Carnegie Ave. west to Main Campus.
- Exit at Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd. (Exit 177) and turn left.
- Drive approximately 2 miles to E. 105th St. and turn right.
- Take E. 105th St. to Main Campus.
- Exit at Chester Ave. (Exit 173B) and turn right.
- Take Chester Ave. to Main Campus.
- Take E. 105th St. to Main Campus.
- Take E. 105th St. to Main Campus.
